name: @svayam-opensource/gov
description: gov-work — the OSS project/workflow CLI for the Governed Agentic Development Framework (Node/TypeScript). Manages projects, workspaces and org registration. Governed catalog/deploy is the separate gov-cicd CLI, and infrastructure the separate gov-infra CLI — independent binaries, not plugins. Succeeds the legacy bash @svayam-opensource/prj (frozen at 0.10.0).
_comment_publishConfig: The DEFAULT publish target is the INTERNAL registry, deliberately. Going public must be an explicit act: the governed recipe passes `--registry <registries[env]>`, so prod (registry.npmjs.org) is reached by saying so, while a bare `npm publish` — a refactor that drops the flag, a hand-run in a checkout — lands somewhere recoverable. npm's unpublish window is 72h and never applies once anything depends on the version, so the safe default is the internal one. `access: public` is required for a scoped package on npmjs and is inert elsewhere.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig-cjs.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run test
